item.title: Salesforce Expands Headless 360 MCP Servers So Agents Can Operate Enterprise CRM
item.summary: Salesforce announced an expansion of its Headless 360 MCP server ecosystem, exposing nearly 200 Data 360 APIs, 100+ reusable Skills, and a Slackbot MCP Client — framing the update as a shift from raw API exposure to governed business capabilities that AI agents can discover and use across enterprise CRM.
